articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially rolled out GPT-5 across its API and ChatGPT tiers, featuring substantially improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a 1M-token context window. Benchmarks show significant gains on ARC-AGI-2 and GPQA, and the model demonstrates markedly better calibration and reduced hallucination rates compared to GPT-4o. Enterprise adoption is expected to accelerate given the model's improved tool-use reliability and structured output adherence.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Unveils Gemini 2.5 Ultra with Breakthrough Scientific Reasoning
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra, which tops multiple scientific reasoning benchmarks including MATH-500 and SciCode. The model introduces a novel mixture-of-experts architecture with dynamic expert routing, enabling significantly lower inference costs while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy. Google is positioning the model as a core engine for its AI-driven drug discovery and materials science partnerships.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Deploys Humanoid Workers in BMW Manufacturing Lines at Scale
articles.summary: Figure announced the expansion of its Figure 02 humanoid robot deployment across three BMW manufacturing plants in the US, marking one of the largest commercial humanoid deployments to date. The robots handle bin-picking, parts transfer, and quality inspection tasks with a reported 99.2% uptime. The partnership validates the commercial viability of general-purpose humanoid form factors in structured industrial settings.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Task Completion
articles.summary: Tesla showcased its third-generation Optimus humanoid performing end-to-end household chores including laundry folding, dishwashing, and shelf organization without teleoperation. The system uses a vision-language-action model trained on large-scale simulation and real-world demonstration data. While consumer availability timelines remain uncertain, the demo represents a marked improvement in dexterous manipulation and long-horizon task planning over previous generations.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Agents with Persistent Memory and Autonomous Execution
articles.summary: Anthropic launched a new agentic framework for Claude that supports persistent memory across sessions, autonomous multi-step tool use, and a sandboxed code execution environment with configurable permissions. The system is aimed at software engineering and data analysis workflows, with early enterprise users reporting 40-60% reductions in repetitive engineering tasks. The release intensifies competition in the AI coding agent space against OpenAI Codex and Google Jules.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that its N1.4 process node has entered volume production at its Fab 20 facility in Hsinchu, approximately one quarter ahead of the original roadmap. The node delivers a 20% performance uplift and 30% power reduction over N2, with backside power delivery and gate-all-around transistor refinements. Leading AI chip designers including NVIDIA and Apple are expected to be first customers, with products shipping in late 2026.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins with First Wave of High-Risk System Audits
articles.summary: The European Union commenced formal enforcement of the AI Act's high-risk system provisions, with national authorities in France, Germany, and the Netherlands initiating compliance audits of AI systems used in hiring, credit scoring, and law enforcement. Companies found non-compliant face fines up to 35 million euros or 7% of global revenue. The enforcement is being closely watched as a template for AI governance frameworks under consideration in other jurisdictions.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with 2 Trillion Parameters Under Permissive License
articles.summary: Meta released the full weights of Llama 4 Behemoth, its largest open-weight model at over 2 trillion parameters using a massive mixture-of-experts architecture. The model matches or exceeds proprietary frontier models on multiple reasoning and coding benchmarks, and is released under a revised Llama license that permits commercial use with minimal restrictions. The release further accelerates the open-source AI ecosystem and raises questions about the competitive moat of closed-model providers.
